newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Prometheus loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Europegasus loading 25,000 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, nine vessels to load using big bags, one to load bulk. Road: 230 trucks arrived carrying sugar between May 23 and 25. Total for May so far 2,482 trucks.
Vessels: None. Waiting to dock, Araya to load 35,200 tonnes bulk sugar and five vessels to each load 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar (Unisea, Daiana P, Fulvia, Qing Jiang and Cormorant).
Stocks: 26,000 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
